answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because ledge only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, gale is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any cedar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
